name: Kees Ploegsma Jr.
status: Active Dutch football agent (as of early 2026). The public record on him in connection with Japan is small: one player, Keisuke Honda.
summary: Dutch agent named in Keisuke Honda's 2009 sale from VVV-Venlo to CSKA Moscow, and quoted as Honda's agent through 2010. An example of a local agent taking over for the big sale.
quick_facts: Youth player at PSV and FC Eindhoven, then amateur football; followed his father into agent work
Kees Ploegsma Sr., also a football agent, quoted in Dutch media on PSV players
Named with SEG, a large Dutch agency, in a 2009 report
Keisuke Honda, 2009 to at least mid-2010

sections.title: In short
sections.intro: When Honda was ready to leave Venlo for a big club, the agent named in the deal was a Dutchman with local contacts, not the Japanese agent from his arrival. Nothing found says whether Ploegsma replaced Tetsuro Kiyooka or worked with him.

cells: A Japanese sports site names him as Honda's agent in the CSKA Moscow talks.
VVV and CSKA agree the transfer. Chairman Hai Berden publicly credits the talks between the two clubs and 'player agent Kees Ploegsma junior'. Reported fee: €9 million.
After Honda's World Cup, he tells media there have been no approaches, that Honda stays in Moscow, but that they would listen to a big club.
Says the same to a Dutch site: no news, Honda is a CSKA player.
By now Honda's brother Hiroyuki is named as his agent in the AC Milan talks.
PSV winger Zakaria Bakkali switches to him during a contract stand-off with the club.
Guest on an Eindhoven football podcast, described as a player agent in professional football for some years.

sections.title: Controversies and criticism
sections.intro: Two items came up. Neither could be fully confirmed.

rows: A 2009 Dutch report says he was among agents accused, in a case before the Dutch FA, of approaching players younger than 16. I did not find the outcome.
An agent-directory website says his work with Honda at CSKA Moscow led to a sports-court case over unpaid commission and oral agreements. I found no court document or news report to confirm it.
The agent who gets you in is not always the agent who gets you up. A big sale needs someone the buying clubs already know.
Honda changed representation at each stage: a Japanese agent to arrive, a Dutch agent for the sale, his own brother later. Yoshida's advice to choose an agent carefully fits this pattern.

unverified: Whether he replaced Kiyooka as Honda's agent or worked alongside him.
When and why Honda stopped working with him.
How he and Honda met. One low-quality site says at a dinner about 18 months before mid-2010.
His current agency and client list. One podcast page mentions well-known clients but the names could not be read.
Do not confuse him with his father, Kees Ploegsma Sr., who is also quoted as an agent.
The outcome of the 2009 Dutch FA case, and whether the sports-court commission case existed as described.
